exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb + tsumori (to intend/plan to)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞＋つもり matches "Verb + tsumori (to intend/plan to)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞＋つもり.
exercises.explanation: Expresses intention or plan to do something using the plain verb form.
